candidate.title: HTGTS
candidate.scope: One unbranched Illumina library-construction schematic from genomic DNA to purified tagged DNA. The image labels HTGTS; the verified matching collection page captions HTGTS-Rep-seq. Both names are retained as assigned targets, with the drawn end-processing/adapter-before-capture route resolved by primary Figure 1a as original HTGTS. HTGTS-Rep-seq is supported only at the shared sonicated-genomic-DNA interface here; its distinct repertoire target and the conflicting preparation assignment are explicit. This is a schematic-level architecture, not the complete experimental protocol, a generic LAM-HTGTS substitution, or all assays named in the catalogue.

states.label: Genomic DNA containing locus-linked rearrangements
features: Genomic DNA substrate; the left icon marks a genomic break region in yellow, without depicting break induction, cell culture or extraction.

For the drawn HTGTS route, informative molecules contain already joined bait–prey translocation junctions, rather than isolated free DSB ends. The starting population need not consist exclusively of rearranged molecules.

The caption-named HTGTS-Rep-seq target concerns rearranged Ig V(D)J sequences in B-cell genomic DNA. This is a distinct biological target; only the generic genomic-DNA/sonication interface is shared here.
